title: My Skills

items./myskills find <task>: (Search: tell me what you want to do and I will find a Skill)
items./myskills list: (Inventory: see active searchable Skills; five results by default)
items./myskills loaded: (Loaded: see Skills loaded for this task)
items./myskills show <name>: (Details: see what a Skill can do)

items./myskills providers: (Providers: see whether Skills come from local files, plugins, or elsewhere)
items./myskills routing <name>: (Routing: see why this Skill was selected or rejected)
items./myskills lifecycle <name>: (Lifecycle: enable, pause, update, or quarantine a Skill)
items./myskills risks <name>: (Risks: view the permissions and security risks of a Skill)
items./myskills conflicts: (Conflicts: check duplicates, conflicts, formatting, and dependencies)

navigation./myskills back: (Back: return to the My Skills menu)
navigation./helpme home: (Home: return to the CapabilityHub main menu)

footer: Reply with a number, a Skill name, or simply say what you want to do.
unknown: I do not understand this Skill action: {topic}
